model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)", has a logarithmic scale, ranges from 2^0 to 2^8, and has tick labels at powers of 2 from 2^0 to 2^8. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.4 to 0.9 (though the exact upper limit is not visible), and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1 from 0.4 to 0.9 (though the uppermost visible tick is 0.8). Three lines are plotted: a dark blue solid line representing Llama-3B, which starts at approximately (2^0, 0.45) and ends at (2^8, 0.9), showing a steady increase; a light blue solid line representing Llama-1B, starting at around (2^0, 0.4) and ending at (2^8, 0.83), also increasing steadily; and a light green dashed line with triangle markers representing Llama-1B + FT, beginning at about (2^0, 0.35) and ending at (2^8, 0.85), exhibiting a consistent upward trend.
